audit.intended_rules: Ch. 4 advance-booking window: the 7-day rejection threshold (ticket issued exactly 8 days before departure is fine) plus the note stating the business reason; Ch. 4 mandatory taxes/surcharges fully reimbursable (LuftVSt, PSC, security fee); economy mandate on short domestic segments.
realism_issues: Base fare €214.99 plus €67.81 in fees is on the high side for a 1h15m HAM-MUC one-way, but plausible for a late-booked walk-up fare; not a flagged violation.
audit.notes: Validator passes; no label.json or receipt.jpg. Correct adjudication: approved in full, €282.80. The case is a near-threshold distractor: issued 8 calendar days before departure (2024-03-12 → 2024-03-20), just outside the 7-day rejection window from the Ch. 4 card-dont, and the note states the trip purpose anyway. All fee lines are mandatory taxes/charges and fully reimbursable; economy is mandatory and booked. No deductions, no interacting rules. Fits the "valid" target with genuine tension near a threshold.
